en: Monochrome postcard showing a riverside industrial facility surrounded by forest. In the foreground there is a brick building with a tall chimney and stacks of cut timber. A smaller structure with a hipped roof stands near the riverbank where people appear to be working. Along the water's edge several small piers or floating platforms extend into a wide river. In the background are scattered wooden houses and dense trees. Printed Russian text appears in the upper right corner.
